queries: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg, COUNT(*) AS phase_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.phase_avg) AS average_bandwidth_average, COALESCE(SUM(p.phase_count), 0) AS total_count, AVG(p.phase_avg - m.mean_avg) AS average_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.phase_avg > m.mean_avg;

WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth) AS average_bandwidth, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_count, AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth) AS average_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth;

WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.phase_avg) AS average_bandwidth_average, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_count, AVG(p.phase_avg - a.mean_phase_avg) AS average_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE p.phase_avg > a.mean_phase_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The phase count includes matched telescopes with missing bandwidth usage; missing usage is excluded only from averages. Phases with no nonmissing usage have a NULL average and do not contribute to the mean of phase averages.
